question.text: Which entity is the lead agency for implementing eNAM?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) is the lead agency for implementing eNAM under the aegis of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India. The Trap: SEBI regulates commodity derivatives, not the spot agricultural market platform. NCDEX is an exchange, not the implementing agency. FCI handles food procurement, not eNAM. Note: The workbook identifies SFAC by name as the lead agency; specific APMC integration counts are not stated on this page.
